subject: [hw] DONE DEC03 rev 2: HEVC_VLD engine added and vendor-tested; N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2435/2435
body:
DONE DEC03 rev 2. Supersedes the first DONE with the HEVC_VLD engine and its vendor differential. Host only: no phone, no publish.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2435/2435
  N2VLD checks 803 pass 803 x2; N2VLDV checks 414 pass 414 x2; arm64 iOS compile ok.
  Optional oracle: bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/oracle_ref.sh -> N2TEST DEC03-oracle PASS 12/12.

What is new since the first DONE:
- HEVC_VLD at 0x16028000. vdec_drv_init_hw_info @0x1e1b8 writes 0x28000 to hw+0x160; vdec_hal_read_hevc_vld @0x2c7dc uses hw+4*core+0x160. The engine is the same MSB-first bit reader and vfifo as AVC, with: reg 0 = peek 32, reg n = consume n, reg 0x26 = ue(v), reg 0x27 = se(v), reg 0x21 bits 8..10 = trailing-bit position. Evidence: vdec_hal_h265_ue_code_num @0xe8ec6 (0x26), se_code_num @0xe8ed0 (0x27), get_bits @0xe8c48 (0x20 + remainder), get_real_bit_stream @0xe8e7a, get_bit_stream_flg @0xe8ea6, trailing_bits @0xe955c.
- t_vendor.c now provides vdec_hal_read_hevc_vld as a host shim and calls the vendor's own vdec_hal_h265_* readers under the interpreter on the same 20 ue / 11 se / 8 bit-width / trailing-bit vectors. All literals match. H265_parseSPS/PPS remain software (RBSP helpers); H265_parseSliceHeader is the consumer of this engine.
- The model maps HEVC_VLD through both VDEC_MISC (win 7, 0x16025000+0x4000) and VDEC_ALL (win 12, +0x28000), so either window works when the T02 hook lands.

Unchanged / still not done:
- The T02 hook is still proposed, not in tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c; the suite drives the exact signature through a wrapper. Integration remains one call plus the bus.
- LAT_VLD is only the fetch-ok word (+0xe8 = reg 0x3a, returns 1); LAT_AVC_VLD (0x16012000) is not modelled because no H.264 LAT syntax parse was observed.
- VLD pointer fields 0x3b/0x3f/0x34 and 0x2c/0x44 are [I]; read_avc_vld(n>0)/HEVC read(n) return value is [I] (no live caller uses it); EPB across a NAL boundary is [I].
- No phone run.
- The corrected header oracle stands: vsi.pic.pic_w/pic_h and buf_w/buf_h are coded sizes; vsi.crop[2..3] is the display rectangle (320x240, 1920x1088/1080, 1920x816/808 in the test). Use crop, not pic_h, in DEC01/DEC05/DEC06.

Files: gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/{n2vld.h,n2vld.c,t_vld.c,t_vendor.c,run_tests.sh,oracle_ref.sh,REGISTERS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/DEC03/STATUS.md. 108 KB, no file over 300 KB, SPDX MIT. Staying available for review findings.
